article_title: Harness 工程：让 AI Agent 真正可靠

Style/medium: conceptual editorial illustration combined with cozy slice-of-life illustration, warm natural light, soft domestic details, calm pacing, gentle hand-drawn texture. Color palette: warm ivory, natural wood brown, sage green, soft sky blue, small amber highlights. Visible text policy: render only '模型', 'Harness', and '可靠闭环'; no title, sentences, extra labels, numbers, code, fake UI, watermark, or prompt residue. Constraints: exactly one dominant machine, seven outer modules readable through shape and connection rather than dense labels, clear central-core versus surrounding-system relationship, no brand logos, no screenshots, no decorative icon collage.
